answer_4.quote: Finally, as our core thrust is topic interpretability, we employ a user study to derive additional insights from the reinterpretation process (Section 8).
answer_4.guideline: For Task I, participants are shown a pair of composite-component topics and asked to identify which of the two is more coherent. For Task II, participants are shown a group of topics and asked to check which topics they think are coherent and if the composite topic is related to its components.
